Problem Statement:
The longest common prefix for N strings of length at most M each is defined as a string KSuch that every string has K as a prefix.You are given the task of finding the longest common prefix for N such strings.
input_spec: The first line contains a single integer N : the number of stringsThe next N line contains the N strings - one in each lineAll strings consists of only lowercase alphabets from ‘a’-’z’
output_spec: Output a single line : the longest common prefix of the N strings .If no longest common prefix exists output “No common prefix exists”
